speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our examination, could you please describe the specific lesion you are concerned about, including its location, size, and how long it has been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any changes in the size or appearance of these lesions over time, and are they associated with any pain, bleeding, or discharge? Given your smoking history and the chronic nature of the sores, have you had any unprotected sexual contact or been tested for HPV or syphilis recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Non-healing, crusty, red lesions on the penile shaft and left middle finger. I also have Lesions are painless, History of unsuccessful treatment for syphilis and eczema.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the painless, non-healing nature of these lesions and your history of failed syphilis treatment, I need to rule out malignancy or other chronic infections. REQUEST TEST: Biopsy of penile and finger lesions, Syphilis serology (RPR/FTA-ABS), and HPV testing.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Biopsy: Cells with nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures within the follicle-bearing epithelium. Syphilis: Negative. HPV: Not specified in data.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No known malignancies or hereditary diseases in the family. Previous treatments for syphilis and eczema. Social history: Lives with his 4th wife, smokes 2 packs of cigarettes per day for the last 30 years, has recently immigrated from Africa.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies any systemic symptoms such as fever, weight loss, night sweats, or malaise. No other similar lesions elsewhere on the body. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pneumonia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: That assessment of pneumonia seems entirely unrelated to your skin lesions, so we must focus on the biopsy results and your history.
